description: Sample automation workflows. Create via POST /api/workflows, or run scripts/seed_examples.py to load a curated set. `schedule` is a 5-field cron (min hour day-of-month month day-of-week) or "manual".

workflows.name: Morning briefing
workflows.prompt: Summarize my open tasks, flag anything due today, and propose my top 3 priorities for the day in a short, direct list.

workflows.name: Weekly business review
workflows.prompt: Review my progress toward my revenue goal, note wins and blockers from the week, and suggest three concrete growth experiments for next week.

workflows.name: Competitor watch
workflows.prompt: Search for news and product launches from AI personal-assistant companies in the last week and summarize what is strategically notable for me.

workflows.name: Daily learning nudge
workflows.prompt: Based on my goals and skill gaps in memory, teach me one useful concept today in under 200 words with a concrete example.

workflows.name: Monthly finance snapshot
workflows.prompt: Produce a simple month-over-month view of my key numbers and highlight anything trending the wrong way. Note this is not financial advice.

workflows.name: Content idea generator
workflows.prompt: Generate 5 social post ideas in my voice about what I'm building, each with a hook and a one-line body.
